spec: Principia/Record/Reaudit.lean: reaudit_batch, the successor's re-audit in one call (TPS 4.1.9)
note: hand-written from the repromote_batch case RB01 and the reaudit_scope cases RA01 and RA04 of record_corpus, each RESULT given DERIVATION_CLASS INSPECTION so that it passes record_check at LANDED, and a failed re-check made by removing it (REC-43). Each case gives the two Research Assemblies and the two registers whole: the assembly is the spring of RB01 with the law KIN removed, so that the equations-of-motion analysis leaves x under-determined (UNDER x), and for RX13 the spring with a DOF theta that a constraint fixes and no Correspondence Table entry ties (IC2 theta), for RX17 both; the predecessor's register carries the PROMOTION record that makes its RESULTs ESTABLISHED, and a REFUTED word is the record's STATUS. RX01 to RX11 and RX13 restate the cases of the earlier input form with their answers unchanged but for REGISTER; RX12, whose dst_words the input no longer takes, refuses a dst_records that is not a register. Expectations written from the Calculator and checked against the functions the batch composes, each called alone: reaudit_scope, record_check, status_next on HOLD, final_checks and eom_findings for the gap DOFs, gap_records, repromote_batch over the words with the changes applied and the gap IDs as open audits, promotion_record; REGISTER against a reference written outside Lean: the successor's records with each STATUS pair applied and the DIGEST from record_digest, then GAPS, then PROMOTION. RX22 to RX24 reach the batch's remaining refusals over a failed re-check: a record whose STATUS HOLD does not apply to (status_next's refusal), a held record whose DIGEST record_digest refuses, and an assembly whose equations of motion do not read, which its final checks refuse first (final_checks NOT_RUN, eom_findings refusing); each expectation equals the answer of the function it reaches, called alone. The final checks owing their verdict (two FIX values of one DOF whose twelve-digit forms the precisions tried do not decide) is the batch's OWED, a request pair of vectors/pcalc.json. RX25 to RX29 reach the reading refusals: a successor register holding two records of one ID (REC-50, as status_words refuses that register), IC2_POLICY REJECT over an untied DOF (final_checks REJECT, REC-39), and a predecessor's assembly that is not an object, or either assembly whose zone does not digest, handed to the scope as given (each equal to reaudit_scope's answer over the zones the batch forms). RX30 to RX32 refuse a re-promotion whose promotion_id is already an ID of the REGISTER the batch would answer: a keyed record of the successor's register, the gap record the re-audit opens, or a positional record of the successor's register (REC-57, as a gap ID already in the register is refused); RX33 refuses a gap ID that is the ID of a positional record of the successor's register (REC-57), as RX10 refuses one that is a keyed record's. RX34 and RX35 give an assembly D_TPK and D_TRM members of its own: a successor whose Starting Set does not digest, carrying the predecessor's digests, and a predecessor given as its digests and Criteria Set alone; the scope is handed each less those members and refuses it (REC-50), each expectation equal to reaudit_scope's answer over the zones the batch forms and the assembly so stripped. RX36 gives the held record a stale DIGEST: REGISTER carries the DIGEST formed again, RX14's answer. RX37 gives RX20's failed re-check a src_records that is not a register: the registers are read before the assembly's DOFs, and the answer is the register's refusal (REC-50). RU01 to RU05 call the batch's UNDER reading (underOf) alone: its refusal of an assembly whose equations of motion do not read, which the batch itself never reaches since the final checks refuse such an assembly first, three readings that answer (RU02, and RU04 and RU05 with the Criteria Set's PARAMETERS or the Criteria Set itself absent, STRUCTURE_CHECK then ON), and STRUCTURE_CHECK OFF
